Subscribe to receive email updates

Subscribe to the HMRC help and support email service to get information on a wide range of topics for individuals, businesses, employers and agents.

You can also:

make changes to your topic subscriptions

unsubscribe from the service whenever you want

Registering and joining webinars

You can register for webinars in advance but we recommend you join each webinar 5 minutes before the start.

How to get ready for Making Tax Digital — the agent services account (ASA)

Live webinar

Register for the next live webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital — the agent services account (ASA).

This Making Tax Digital for Income Tax webinar is aimed at agents and explains the ASA.

You will learn about:

what an ASA is

creating an ASA if you do not already have one

how to add existing client authorisations for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax after you’ve created your ASA

adding new client authorisations

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital — the agent services account (ASA).

Get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re an agent

Live webinar

Register for the next live webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re an agent.

This webinar will help you understand the requirements for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and the steps you can take to prepare you and your client.

You will learn about:

who Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies to

what you and your clients will need to do

software choices

updating the agent services account

signing up your clients

following the rules

benefits and opportunities

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about how to get ready for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re an agent.

Making Tax Digital for Income Tax for agents

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax for agents.

If your clients have income from property or self-employment, you will be legally required to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from:

6 April 2026 (for qualifying income over £50,000)

6 April 2027 (for qualifying income over £30,000)

6 April 2028 (for qualifying income over £20,000)

You will learn about:

using HMRC recognised software

keeping digital records throughout the year

sending simple quarterly updates to HMRC

Work out your client’s qualifying income for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.

An introduction to the temporary repatriation facility (TRF)

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about the temporary repatriation facility (TRF).

This webinar will give an introductory overview of the TRF including what it is, how it works and who it applies to.

You will learn about:

the designation process

the definition of qualifying overseas capital

uncertain amounts

time limits and record keeping

mixed fund ordering rules

offshore transfer rules and capital accounts

joint accounts and third parties

We will also talk about how the rules are applied in different situations and give some examples.

The temporary repatriation facility (TRF) and trusts

Before you join these sessions you should:

understand the remittance basis

be aware of offshore anti-avoidance rules

understand the background to the non-domiciled reforms introduced in Finance Act 2025

This topic is covered over 2 sessions. Make sure you sign up for both part 1 and part 2.

Part 1

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about the temporary repatriation facility (TRF) and trusts — Part 1.

You will learn about:

important TRF principles

how the TRF applies to trust capital distributions and differs from personal foreign income and gains

qualifying overseas capital in relation to trust structure payments

TRF treatment for trust benefits taxed under the transfer of assets abroad provisions

Part 2

Recorded webinar

Watch a recorded webinar about the temporary repatriation facility (TRF) and trusts — Part 2.

You will learn about:

TRF treatment of trust benefits under the settlements provisions

capital payments from non-resident trusts

TRF treatment under capital gains provisions

the concept of virtual matching

The webinars will focus only on the TRF and will not cover other aspects of the reforms.
